rows.definition: The agent interface the Inkling-2 chat planner drives to decode one request: Generate prefills the prompt on a fresh KV cache and hands each greedy id to emit until a stop id, emit refusal or maxNew. fak serve backs it with the serialized engine or, opt-in, the cohort batch engine.
rows.distinction: A DECODE CONTRACT the planner calls, not the looped depth forward itself and not a session: it owns no KV state between calls and says nothing about recurrence passes.

rows.definition: The receipt one Inkling2LoopGenerator.Generate call returns: ids generated, whether a stop ended it, the cohort width that served it, and prefill and decode seconds for the response timings.
rows.distinction: A PER-CALL RESULT record, not a model generation or version and not a loop iteration count.

rows.definition: The widest cohort, in sequences, that one row-batched Inkling-2 decode forward serves; fak serve's admission window closes a cohort at this width.
rows.distinction: A SEQUENCE-COUNT ceiling on one batched forward, not a token batch, prefill chunk or recurrence-pass bound.

rows.definition: The token capacity, prompt plus generated, of one resident Inkling-2 device session (FAK_INKLING2_CTX, default 4096); fak serve caps request budgets at it and sizes cohort KV no larger than it.
rows.distinction: A PER-SESSION KV capacity of the device-resident path, not the model's trained context length and not an agent context window; the host path has no fixed bound.
